material.description: GAO Green Book paragraph 7.02 defines risk in the U.S. federal internal-control context as the possibility of an event that adversely affects achievement of objectives; it also states that assessment scope and frequency consider entity objectives and risk tolerances. This supports only the adverse-event/objective and context-dependent assessment components. It does not establish the broader positive-and-negative uncertainty framing in the Claim and is not a substitute for ISO 31000. The ISO source remains excluded from AI evidence use under the existing rights hold.
